This paper is mainly a benchmark of LLM agents calling MCP tools, which is not RAG. However, it includes an architectural ablation that replaces MCP execution with text-based RAG over telemetry-equivalent evidence and compares the two on the battery class. The rules say to INCLUDE a paper that "compares RAG with other settings" in experiments, and this ablation does that. The RAG component is minor, but it is a run experiment with a RAG system, and the paper is not a pure dataset description, since it reports new experiments. INCLUDE is defensible, though the match is borderline. I choose INCLUDE.

{"decision": "INCLUDE", "code": null, "reason": "Benchmark includes ablation comparing text-based RAG against MCP tool execution on prognostics."}
